bio.text: James Martin is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 21st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Hobe Sound, Florida, graduated from the U.S. Coast Guard Academy with a degree in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering, and served nearly ten years in the Coast Guard.
The site says he commanded two Coast Guard cutters in Fort Pierce and was Chief of Staff for National Security Affairs in the Office of the Vice President from 2022 to 2025.
He holds a commission as a lieutenant commander in the Coast Guard Reserve.
